name: Aboshan Trench
description: Submerged part of Otaria; main theatre of the Mer civil war.

timeline.summary: Laquatus starts a civil war in the Mer Empire and schemes with both Order and Cabal; the First sacrifices Skellum in the pits, devastating Chainer.
timeline.quote: In his plotting, he sacrifices Skellum, who dies in the pits to appease them.

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus's army is defeated in the Aboshan Trench and Llawan's mages trap him in a bubble; he swears revenge.
timeline.quote: Llawan's mages create a bubble that entraps him and what remains of his followers in it.
